repo_notes.content: When documenting or explaining Vietnamese terminology from code references, use GLOSSARY.md as the source of truth. Give every gloss in exactly one of these bilingual forms: vi (en) or en (vi), preserving Vietnamese diacritics. Link claims to source files.

pages.title: Vietnamese Phoneme Transcription
pages.purpose: Document the Vietnamese to CeVIO transcription pipeline, including normalization, syllable segmentation, onset, nucleus and coda mappings, tone handling, and the glossary terms in GLOSSARY.md.
